description: This file contains unit tests for the TextFragment and TextSegmentIterator classes in the core namespace, using the Google Test framework. It tests string manipulation methods, iterators, and comparisons related to text segments.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: Represents a fragment of text, supporting operations like trimming, comparison, and searching.

classes.name: TextSegmentIterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing segments within a TextFragment, supports reset, next, and reverse find operations.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison between TextFragment and buffer string

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison between TextFragment and buffer string

methods.name: TrimBegin
methods.description: Trims specified prefix from a TextFragment

methods.name: TrimEnd
methods.description: Trims specified suffix from a TextFragment

methods.name: ReverseFind
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a substring in a TextFragment

methods.name: ReverseSkip
methods.description: Skips backwards from the end to locate a substring

methods.name: ForwardFind
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a delimiter in a TextFragment

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the contents of a TextFragment

methods.name: OnMarker
methods.description: Checks if a buffer is within the TextFragment

methods.name: EqualText
methods.description: Compares TextFragment's text with a buffer

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the TextSegmentIterator to the next segment

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to initial state
